Free Pool, Billiards and Snooker

Play free online billiards, pool and snooker with realistic physics simulation in your browser. 8-ball, 9-ball, and three-cushion carom games. Open source, no download required — just play. Also available in Korean 당구, Turkish Bilardo, Japanese ビリヤード, Chinese 台球, German Billard, Vietnamese Bida.
